title: Listening Practice Test 20 – Business Development
description: Đề luyện Listening theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 26 câu: Part 1 (2) · Part 2 (6) · Part 3 (9, có hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý và biểu đồ) · Part 4 (9). Chủ đề: hợp tác, mở rộng thị trường, mua lại công ty, tin kinh tế.

groups.transcript:
(A) Some people are fishing from a pier.
(B) Some boats are floating near a dock.
(C) A boat is being pulled onto a beach.
(D) Some sails are being taken down.

options.A: Some people are fishing from a pier.
options.B: Some boats are floating near a dock.
options.C: A boat is being pulled onto a beach.
options.D: Some sails are being taken down.

questions.explanation: Hai chiếc thuyền nổi trên mặt nước cạnh cầu tàu → (B). Không có người (A); các câu bị động tiếp diễn (C), (D) cần có người đang làm.

groups.transcript:
(A) Some people are sitting around a fountain.
(B) A fountain is being cleaned.
(C) Some trees are being planted in a park.
(D) Some benches have been placed near a fountain.

options.A: Some people are sitting around a fountain.
options.C: Some trees are being planted in a park.
options.D: Some benches have been placed near a fountain.

questions.explanation: Hai chiếc ghế băng được đặt hai bên đài phun nước → (D). Không có người nên (A), (B), (C) đều sai.

groups.transcript:
Who will lead the negotiations with the new supplier?
(A) By next Tuesday.
(B) A new supply of paper.
(C) Mr. Dubois from purchasing.

questions.explanation: Who → ông Dubois phòng thu mua. (A) trả lời When; (B) bẫy 'supplier' – 'supply'.

groups.transcript:
Did the board approve the merger?
(A) It's written on the board.
(B) They'll vote on it next week.
(C) Please merge the two files.

options.B: They'll vote on it next week.

questions.explanation: Hỏi hội đồng quản trị đã duyệt việc sáp nhập chưa → 'Tuần sau họ mới biểu quyết' (tức là chưa). (A) 'board' với nghĩa tấm bảng; (C) bẫy 'merger' – 'merge'.

groups.transcript:
What's the main goal of opening a branch in Seoul?
(A) To reach more customers in Asia.
(B) It opens at ten.
(C) Near the main office.

options.A: To reach more customers in Asia.

questions.explanation: What's the goal → mục đích: tiếp cận thêm khách hàng châu Á. (B) bẫy 'opening' – 'opens'; (C) lặp 'main', trả lời Where.

groups.transcript:
Why don't we ask a consultant for advice?
(A) We consulted the map.
(B) Because it was advised.
(C) Good idea, but it could be expensive.

options.C: Good idea, but it could be expensive.

questions.explanation: Lời đề nghị → đồng ý nhưng nêu lo ngại chi phí. (A) bẫy 'consultant' – 'consulted'; (B) bẫy 'Because' và 'advice' – 'advised'.

groups.transcript:
How was the sales conference in Dubai?
(A) Very informative.
(B) By plane.
(C) I sold it yesterday.

questions.explanation: 'How was…?' hỏi cảm nhận → 'Rất bổ ích'. (B) trả lời 'How did you get there?'; (C) bẫy 'sales' – 'sold'.

groups.transcript:
Aren't we launching the new product line in May?
(A) We had lunch in May.
(B) Actually, it's been pushed back to June.
(C) She's a product manager.

options.B: Actually, it's been pushed back to June.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi phủ định xác nhận thông tin → 'Thật ra đã lùi sang tháng Sáu' (push back = hoãn lại). (A) bẫy âm 'launching' – 'lunch'; (C) lặp 'product'.

groups.transcript:
W: Hi, Mr. Tanaka. This is Elena Novak from Brightstar Cosmetics. Thank you for sending your proposal for a partnership.
M: My pleasure. What did you think?
W: We're very interested in selling your skin-care products in our stores. But we'd like to test them in five of our stores before signing a long-term contract.
M: That sounds reasonable. How long would the trial last?
W: About three months. If sales are good, we'd expand to all forty stores.
M: Great. I'll send you product samples next week.

questions.content: What is the purpose of the call?
questions.explanation: 'Thank you for sending your proposal for a partnership… We're very interested…'

questions.content: What does the woman want to do first?

options.C: Run a trial in some stores

questions.explanation: 'We'd like to test them in five of our stores before signing a long-term contract.'

questions.content: What will the man send next week?
questions.explanation: 'I'll send you product samples next week.'

groups.transcript:
M1: So, the question is whether we should open our next café in Brookfield or in Maple Heights.
W: Brookfield has lower rent. But there aren't many offices nearby.
M2: Maple Heights has three universities within walking distance.
M1: That's a lot of potential customers who drink coffee.
W: True. The rent is higher, but we'd probably have more customers every day.
M2: I'll prepare a cost comparison, so we can present both options to the owner on Friday.

options.B: Where to open a new branch

questions.explanation: '…whether we should open our next café in Brookfield or in Maple Heights' → chọn địa điểm mở chi nhánh mới.

questions.content: Why does one of the men say, “Maple Heights has three universities within walking distance”?

options.A: To explain why rent is high
options.C: To suggest a partnership with a school
options.D: To indicate a large customer base

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: có ba trường đại học gần đó → nhiều khách hàng tiềm năng; người kia nói ngay 'That's a lot of potential customers'.

questions.content: What will one of the men do before Friday?
questions.explanation: 'I'll prepare a cost comparison, so we can present both options to the owner on Friday.'

groups.transcript:
M: We need to decide where to open our European headquarters. I've narrowed it down to these four cities.
W: Our clients will be flying in often, so the office should be within thirty minutes of the airport.
M: Agreed. And our budget for rent is ten thousand dollars a month.
W: Then we have two options. I'd choose the less expensive one.
M: Me too. I'll get in touch with a real estate agent there tomorrow.

questions.explanation: 'We need to decide where to open our European headquarters.'

questions.content: Look at the graphic. Which city will the speakers most likely choose?
questions.explanation: Điều kiện: cách sân bay dưới 30 phút và giá thuê tối đa $10,000 → còn Lisbon và Vienna; chọn nơi rẻ hơn → Lisbon ($8,500).

questions.content: What will the man do tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 'I'll get in touch with a real estate agent there tomorrow.'

groups.transcript: In business news, Ardent Motors announced yesterday that it will build a new electric vehicle factory just outside the city of Riverton. The factory is expected to create about one thousand two hundred jobs when it opens in two years. Company officials said Riverton was chosen because of its skilled workforce and its location near a major port. Construction will begin in March. Local business owners say they expect the project to bring more customers to shops and restaurants in the area.

questions.explanation: '…it will build a new electric vehicle factory' – factory = cơ sở sản xuất.

questions.content: According to the report, why was Riverton chosen?
questions.explanation: '…because of its skilled workforce and its location near a major port.' (D) sai: gần cảng biển chứ không phải sân bay.

questions.content: What do local business owners expect?
questions.explanation: 'They expect the project to bring more customers to shops and restaurants' → kinh doanh tốt hơn.

groups.transcript: Good morning, everyone. I have exciting news. Last night, we signed an agreement to acquire Pixel Labs, a small software company in Seattle. Pixel Labs has developed an image-recognition tool that we'll add to our mobile app. Their team of fifteen engineers will join our research department next month. Now, I know many of you are wondering about job changes. No positions here will be affected. Our HR director will hold a question-and-answer session this Thursday afternoon.

options.A: The opening of a new office

questions.explanation: 'We signed an agreement to acquire Pixel Labs' – acquire = mua lại (purchase).

options.C: Some engineers will join a department.
options.D: A new director will be hired.

questions.explanation: 'Their team of fifteen engineers will join our research department next month.'

questions.content: Why does the speaker say, “I know many of you are wondering about job changes”?

options.A: To address a concern among employees

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: bà đoán nhân viên lo lắng về việc làm sau thương vụ mua lại, nên trấn an ngay 'No positions here will be affected'.

groups.intro: excerpt from a meeting and chart
groups.transcript: Let's review last year's sales by region. As expected, the East region performed best, thanks to the new distribution center there. However, the region with the lowest sales will be our focus this year. We've hired a new regional manager, Amelia Brooks, who has fifteen years of experience in the industry. She'll be visiting all our stores in that region over the next month. I'd like each of you to send her any information that might be useful.

questions.content: Look at the graphic. Which region will Amelia Brooks be responsible for?
questions.explanation: Quản lý mới phụ trách khu vực có doanh số thấp nhất – theo biểu đồ là South ($2.1 triệu).

questions.content: According to the speaker, why did the East region perform well?
questions.explanation: '…thanks to the new distribution center there.'

questions.content: What are the listeners asked to do?

options.C: Share useful information with a new manager

questions.explanation: 'I'd like each of you to send her any information that might be useful.' (A) là việc của Amelia Brooks.
